units.source_text: "刚才我们在电车上争吵起来了。

en.t: "Just now we had an argument on the train.

units.source_text: 是这么回事，她家逼她同一个她讨厌的男人结婚，

en.t: This is what happened: her family was forcing her to marry a man she hated,

units.source_text: 她很懦怯，眼看就要屈服啦，

en.t: and she was so timid that she was on the verge of giving in,

units.source_text: 所以我半安慰半威胁地说，我要坚决阻挠这桩婚事！"

en.t: so, half comforting her and half threatening her, I said that I would firmly block this marriage!"
